question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**suspicion**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes Paul feeling uneasy due to Aunt Jenny's deceitful questions.
 
• The word "**suspicion**" reflects a state of doubt or mistrust, aligning with Paul's discomfort.
 
• "**Suspicion**" fits well as it accurately conveys Paul's uneasy feeling.
 
• Other options ("**guess**", "**view**", "**drop**") do not appropriately describe an uneasy or mistrustful feeling.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.
